name: @cb/creator-worker

scripts.test:real-context-compiler: pnpm run pretest && COMBO_REAL_CODEX_E2E=1 vitest run src/__tests__/project-context-compiler.real.test.ts --reporter=verbose
scripts.test:real-package: pnpm run pretest && COMBO_REAL_CODEX_E2E=1 vitest run src/__tests__/agent-package-session.real.test.ts --reporter=verbose
